mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDP growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over the last 2 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both proxies increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate, signals a strong labor market, which increases consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the CPI increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales by more than 1% over the last month signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
